 Dengue fever claims 418 lives in Bangladesh
 Dengue fever claims 418 lives in Bangladesh
 November 01, 2026 / 9:44 AM 
 Share 
 Sharjah24 - WAM: Bangladesh recorded its highest monthly dengue death toll of the year in October, with experts warning the outbreak is unlikely to ease significantly before December, Reuters reported.
 The outbreak caused 418 deaths and more than 133,000 hospital admissions between the start of the year and October 30, health ministry figures showed. October recorded 173 deaths, up from 148 in September, making it the deadliest month of 2026 so far.
The rise coincides with Bangladesh’s battle against the world’s worst measles outbreak, which has claimed more than 1,200 lives and intensified pressure on the country’s already overstretched healthcare system.
